portX_mm.x-tooltip: Where the IC draws current (its power pins). Leave blank for the one-third point of the board width: no cavity mode has a voltage null there, so every mode shows on the plot. The board centre hides every mode with an odd index.

portY_mm.x-tooltip: Where the IC draws current, along the board length. Leave blank for the one-third point of the board length (see Port X location).

portSize_mm.x-tooltip: Side of the square through which the IC current enters the planes (roughly its power-pin field). The plane spreading inductance depends on it. A port over an edge is modelled with its image.

vrmBandwidth_hz.x-tooltip: VRM control loop bandwidth — the VRM provides low impedance only below this frequency

boardInductance_nh.x-tooltip: Inductance between the regulator and the planes (vias, traces, connector), in series with the VRM.

targetImpedance_mohm.x-tooltip: Flat target impedance. Z_PDN is judged against it across the decoupling band, up to 0.8 × the first cavity mode.

maxCapCount.x-tooltip: Total decoupling capacitor budget the optimizer may place

randomSeed.x-tooltip: Blank derives the seed from the parameters, so the same job repeats exactly. Set it to draw a different sample of the same design.
